Methodology & Verification Controls

Risk Engine Formulation: Explaining risk via NTRO formula: 100 × (0.35×QuantumExposure + 0.25×BusinessCriticality + 0.15×ExposureSurface + 0.15×DataSensitivity + 0.10×(1 - CryptoAgility)).

Mosca Condition: Evaluates X (Data Lifetime) + Y (Migration Time) > Z (CRQC Horizon) where Z is an explicitly parameterized scenario horizon (default: 2035).

CBOM Specification: CycloneDX 1.6 Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) with strict schema validation against official specifications.
